SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '09' THEN qty * unit_price ELSE 0 END) as september_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '10' THEN qty * unit_price ELSE 0 END) as october_sales
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2026'

SELECT (october_sales - september_sales) as change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '09' THEN qty * unit_price ELSE 0 END) as september_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '10' THEN qty * unit_price ELSE 0 END) as october_sales
    FROM order_items
    JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
    WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
    AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2026'
)

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
     JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
     AND p.category_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4)) AS digital_sales,
    (SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')) AS total_sales;
SELECT (209330.25 / 229474.7) * 100 AS percentage;

SELECT SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN orders.id END) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1
